name: Divorce And Remarrying
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that divorce and remarriage are serious matters, with Jesus emphasizing that anyone who divorces their spouse, except for the cause of sexual immorality, causes adultery both in the act of putting away and in marrying another. The passages in Matthew 5:32, Matthew 19:9, and Luke 16:18 consistently affirm that remarriage after divorce, except when the divorce is on the grounds of fornication, results in adultery. This underscores the sanctity and permanence of marriage as ordained by God, allowing separation only in the specific circumstance of marital unfaithfulness.
